summary: Frontend-only verification of /financial-statements period controls, header date lines, and signature strip changes. Logged in as admin/Admin@123 (social-solidarity). Verified: year/from-month/to-month selects + توليد button all present with correct data-testids. Full-year (Jan-Dec 2025): balance-sheet-print-header-date = 'في ٣١ ديسمبر ٢٠٢٥', income-expense-print-header-date = 'عن السنة المنتهية في ٣١ ديسمبر ٢٠٢٥', receipts-payments-print-header-date = 'في ٣١ ديسمبر ٢٠٢٥'. Range Mar-Jun: all three header dates = 'عن الفترة من مارس ٢٠٢٥ إلى يونيو ٢٠٢٥'. All three signature strips contain exactly 2 children: *-treasurer (أمين الصندوق) on the RIGHT (x≈800) and *-chairman (رئيس النقابة العامة) on the LEFT (x≈217). No 'المراجع' text or '-prepared' testids anywhere. All three print sections render without React errors. Numbers are rendered using Arabic-Indic digits (٢٠٢٥) — matches the spec which only required the Arabic text + year token to be present.
critical_code_review_comments: FinancialStatementsPage.jsx is a single very long file (~351 lines, with extremely long inline JSX lines >1000 chars for the controls section). Consider splitting SignatureStrip / ReportHeader / per-statement print components into separate files for readability.

ReportHeader renders year with Arabic-Indic numerals via browser default locale formatting; the spec text used Western digits (2025). Current output ٢٠٢٥ is semantically equivalent but if the stakeholder expects literal '2025' the number formatting should be forced.
seed_data_creation: None; relied on pre-seeded 2025 _tmp_fs journal entries.

Header date switches between 'في 31 ديسمبر {year}' / 'عن السنة المنتهية في 31 ديسمبر {year}' for full year and 'عن الفترة من {month} {year} إلى {month} {year}' for any range. Note digits are rendered in Arabic-Indic form.
